title: ULPF Event Contract
description: Schema for the standard normalized event output. Version 1.1: canonical envelope keys (integrity, parser_id, parser_version, provenance, trusted) are required; ocsf_event may be null but the key is always present.

source_id.description: Identifier of the log source or origin.

ingest_timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the event was ingested.

raw_ref.description: Reference to the original raw log.

locator.description: Content-addressed locator: 'sha256:' prefix followed by the bare hex digest.

raw_hash.description: Bare SHA-256 hex digest of the raw log payload (no 'sha256:' prefix; the prefix appears only on the locator).

evidence_classification.description: Explicit evidence state for the event payload.

parser_id.description: Identifier of the parser used to process this event.

schema_version.description: Version of this event contract schema (e.g., '1.1').

ocsf_event.description: The normalized event fields conforming to OCSF standard. May be null before normalization, but the key is always present.

provenance.description: Metadata regarding the origins and confidence of parsing/detection.

detection_method.description: Method by which the event structure was identified.

confidence.description: Confidence score of the parsing or detection.

source_profile_id.description: ID of the source profile used for authoritative metadata injection.

source_profile_version.description: Version of the source profile used.

integrity.description: Integrity metadata for blockchain or sequential hashing guarantees.

chain_seq.description: Sequence number in the tamper-evident chain.

chain_prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous event in the chain.

checkpoint_ref.description: Reference to a verifiable checkpoint or Merkle root.

trusted.description: Trust gate: true only when evidence_classification is 'validated' AND integrity.status is 'verified' AND integrity.chain_verified is not false.
